# aglaowner

> A commission-free marketplace for selling a business, equipment & assets, a lease/space handover, or excess inventory in India. Sellers pay a one-time listing fee; buyers browse and connect for free. A referral program lets anyone earn credits and vouchers for referring sellers.

## Pages
- [Marketplace](https://aglaowner.vercel.app/): browse and list businesses, equipment, leases, and inventory for sale
- [Sell](https://aglaowner.vercel.app/sell): list a business, equipment, lease, or inventory
- [Buy](https://aglaowner.vercel.app/buy): browse listings by category
- [Find & reactivate](https://aglaowner.vercel.app/reactivate): look up and reactivate an existing listing
- [Referral network](https://aglaowner.vercel.app/referral): get a referral code, earn credits, redeem vouchers

## Notes
No commission is ever charged to buyers or on a completed sale — the platform's only revenue is the one-time seller listing fee.
